input.quote: 21.1 Except for Excluded Claims, each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the Fees paid or payable by Customer under the first Order Form during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim.
input.rationale: Section 21 is mutual, mutually excludes indirect/consequential damages, and carves out (uncapped) confidentiality, data-protection and security breaches, indemnification, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and infringement of the other Party's IP, and confirms Customer's payment obligation is not damages. The cap amount, however, fails the fallback on a material term: it is keyed to "Fees", defined in §1.5/1.6 as the one-time USD 12,000 Implementation Fee, and only under the first Order Form — so it is neither 12 months of fees nor a meaningful cap (effectively USD 12,000 against, e.g., USD 5,000,000 cyber insurance). We therefore reset the basis to all amounts paid or payable in the twelve months preceding the event, with a USD 1,000,000 floor, leaving the rest of §21 intact.

proposal.summary: Recast the mutual cap as the greater of amounts paid or payable in the preceding twelve months and USD 1,000,000, removing reliance on the illusory "Fees"/first-Order-Form basis.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Our position is a mutual cap set at the greater of twelve months' fees and USD 1,000,000. As drafted the cap is keyed to "Fees" (defined as the one-time USD 12,000 Implementation Fee) under the first Order Form only, which is illusory, so we have based it on all amounts paid or payable in the twelve months preceding the event with a USD 1,000,000 floor. Indemnification, confidentiality, data-protection/security, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement remain outside the cap as Excluded Claims.

ops.oldText: the Fees paid or payable by Customer under the first Order Form during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim
ops.newText: the greater of (a) all amounts paid or payable by Customer under this Agreement and all Order Forms during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim and (b) USD 1,000,000
